jobs.occupation: Techniker/in – 10x Genomics / Single-Cell Sequencing (Techniker/in - Biotechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities- Perform end-to-end single-cell sequencing workflows, including sample processing, single-cell dissociation, single-nucleus preparation, cell sorting, quality assessment, and library preparation.- Execute and optimize single-cell experiments using platforms such as 10x Genomics, PARSE, or other single-cell technologies.- Conduct molecular biology experiments including PCR, qPCR, nucleic acid extraction/purification, and NGS-related workflows.- Handle human and mouse tissue samples and optimize protocols for challenging samples to improve experimental performance and data quality.- Operate laboratory instruments including flow cytometers (FACS), cell counters, PCR/qPCR systems, and other molecular biology equipment.- Analyze experimental results, maintain accurate laboratory records, prepare reports, and communicate findings with internal teams and customers when required.- Troubleshoot experimental issues, improve laboratory workflows, and contribute to the development and validation of single-cell methodologies.- Collaborate with research teams and support the training or supervision of junior team members when needed.Requirements- PhD degree in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or related fields,- or a Master’s degree with 1–3 years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience.- Hands-on experience with single-cell sequencing platforms (10x Genomics or equivalent) and related experimental workflows.Experience in:- Single-cell suspension preparation and tissue dissociation (human/mouse tissues)- Single-nucleus extraction/preparation- Flow cytometry/FACS operation- Molecular biology techniques including PCR, qPCR, purification, and NGS workflows- Experience with protocol optimization, troubleshooting, and laboratory SOPs.- Familiarity with organoids, recombinant AAV, screening, or low-input molecular assays is a plus.- Basic experience with data analysis tools (e.g., Prism, Spotfire, or equivalent) and interest in bioinformatics is preferred.- Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a research environment.- Willingness to travel when required.- Proficiency in English (written and spoken).------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Ihre Aufgaben- Durchführung von Single-Cell-Sequencing-Workflows von A bis Z, einschließlich Probenverarbeitung, Einzelzell-Dissoziation, Einzelkernpräparation, Zellsortierung, Qualitätskontrolle und Library Preparation. - Durchführung und Optimierung von Single-Cell-Experimenten mit Plattformen wie 10x Genomics, PARSE oder vergleichbaren Single-Cell-Technologien. - Durchführung molekularbiologischer Arbeiten, einschließlich PCR, qPCR, Nukleinsäureextraktion und -aufreinigung sowie weiterer NGS-bezogener Workflows. - Arbeiten mit humanen und murinen Gewebeproben sowie Optimierung von Protokollen für anspruchsvolle Proben, um die experimentelle Leistung und Datenqualität zu verbessern. - Bedienung und Wartung von Laborgeräten, insbesondere Durchflusszytometern (FACS), Zellzählern, PCR-/qPCR-Systemen und weiteren Geräten der Molekularbiologie. - Analyse und Dokumentation experimenteller Ergebnisse, Führung präziser Laboraufzeichnungen, Erstellung von Berichten sowie Kommunikation der Ergebnisse mit internen Teams und bei Bedarf mit Kunden. - Fehleranalyse und Troubleshooting bei experimentellen Problemen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Laborabläufen und Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Validierung von Single-Cell-Methoden. - Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungs- und Projektteams sowie bei Bedarf Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung und Betreuung von Junior-Teammitgliedern. - Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen. Ihr Profil- Promotion (PhD) in Zellbiologie, Molekularbiologie, Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet oder ein Masterabschluss mit 1–3 Jahren einschlägiger praktischer Laborerfahrung.  - Praktische Erfahrung mit Single-Cell-Sequencing-Plattformen, idealerweise 10x Genomics, sowie mit den entsprechenden experimentellen Workflows. - Praktische Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen: - Herstellung von Einzelzellsuspensionen und Gewebedissoziation aus humanen und murinen Geweben - **Extraktion und Präparation von Einzelkernen (Single Nuclei)** - Bedienung von Durchflusszytometern / FACS - Molekularbiologische Methoden, einschließlich PCR, qPCR, Nukleinsäureaufreinigung und NGS-Workflows- Protokolloptimierung, Troubleshooting und Erstellung bzw. Anwendung von Labor-SOPs - Erfahrung mit Organoiden, rekombinantem AAV, Screening-Verfahren oder Low-Input-Molekularassays ist von Vorteil. - Grundkenntnisse in Datenanalyse-Tools wie Prism, Spotfire oder vergleichbaren Programmen sowie Interesse an Bioinformatik sind wünschenswert. - Gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem wissenschaftlichen Forschungsumfeld. - Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Zwingend erforderlich: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Extrahieren, Extraktgewinnung

Dabei legen Hotelfachleute in allen Abteilungen eines Hotels mit Hand an. Beispielsweise richten sie die Gästezimmer her und kontrollieren sie, bedienen im Restaurant und arbeiten in der Küche mit. Sie organisieren Veranstaltungen und vergeben die Zimmer. Hotelfachleute stellen Rechnungen aus, planen den Personaleinsatz und überwachen beispielsweise das Küchenhilfspersonal. jobs.description: Du willst einen Job, bei dem deine Arbeit wirklich zählt, du gut verdienst und dich auf verlässliche Strukturen verlassen kannst? Willkommen bei KAGETEC.Seit über 38 Jahren verlegen wir hochwertige, extrem belastbare und hygienische keramische Industrieböden für internationale Marktführer aus der Getränke-, Lebensmittel- und Pharmaindustrie.Wie ist es, mit uns zu arbeiten?- Fester Arbeitsplatz (verlässliche langfristige Perspektive)- Gutes Gehalt + Leistungsboni (wir sehen deine Arbeit)- Internationale Projekte (reisen und neue Orte erleben)- Hochwertiges Werkzeug (modern und zuverlässig)- Passende Arbeitskleidung (vom ersten Tag an gestellt)- 30 Tage Urlaub (weil deine Erholung wichtig ist)- Echte Wertschätzung (bei uns möchtest du bleiben)Deine Rolle bei unsArbeitsvorbereitungDu richtest die Baustelle ein, prüfst Materialien und planst den Ablauf so, dass alles reibungslos und effizient läuft.UntergrundvorbereitungDu bereitest den Untergrund sauber, stabil und fachgerecht auf – die Grundlage für ein dauerhaft hochwertiges Ergebnis.Fliesen- und PlattenverlegungDu verlegst Fliesen und Platten, insbesondere Sechseckfliesen, präzise und nach hohen Qualitätsstandards.Zuverlässigkeit & QualitätsbewusstseinDu arbeitest sorgfältig und professionell. Für Montageeinsätze reist du international, hältst Absprachen ein und lieferst Ergebnisse, auf die sich unsere Kunden verlassen können.We specialize in high-quality and durable ceramic industrial floors that are characterized by their high chemical, mechanical and thermal resistence. With over 35 years of experience and a constantly growing, qualified team, we support our customers  from consultation, planning and quotation preparation  through to a professional laying, installation and completion.What to expect:- Future-oriented, permanent position- Attractive compensation: Salary depends on qualification and is paid at a fixed hourly rate, plus allowances. Minimum 18 €/hour for assistants, from 22 €/hour for skilled workers.- 30 days of paid vacation- Modern tools and equipment- International projects (traveling and experiencing new places)Your tasks:As a tiler, you are responsible for the precise preparation and execution of our installation projects. jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager – Petrochemicals & Chemicals (m/f/d) - Düsseldorf (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Your missionWe’re growing – and you can be part of it!NAGASE (EUROPA) GmbH, part of the global NAGASE Group, provides innovative technologies, high-quality materials and tailored solutions across various industries.For our office in Düsseldorf, we are looking for an experienced Key Account Manager (m/f/d) to manage and develop existing international customer relationships and support the continued growth of our petrochemicals and chemicals business.Your Responsibilities• Manage and maintain long-term relationships with existing international customers• Act as the main point of contact for customer inquiries, product requirements and commercial matters• Ensure customer satisfaction and continuously develop existing business relationships• Manage the assigned product portfolio, primarily Petrochemicals and Engineering Plastics• Handle customer inquiries and complaints and coordinate appropriate solutions with internal departments• Coordinate customer requirements, orders, deliveries and negotiate prices with international customers and suppliers• Monitor sales performance, pricing and profitability within the assigned customer portfolio• Work closely with business partners in Japan and Taiwan• Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts and develop additional businessYour profile• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in the petrochemical industry• Proven experience in Key Account Management, international B2B customer management or B2B sales management• Good product and market knowledge in plastics/engineering plastics• Strong commercial and technical understanding• Fluent German and English; Japanese and/or Chinese language skills are an advantage• Excellent communication and relationship management skills• Willingness to travel internationally• Previous work experience in a Japanese company is an advantageWhy us?• Flexible working hours and hybrid working model• Jobticket• Additional company health insurance (BKV)• Company pension scheme• Additional special leave days• Access to an online learning and development platform• Small, dynamic and international team with structured onboarding• Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues• Opportunity to actively contribute to business development within a global organizationBe part of NAGASE’s growth journey – apply now!About usWe are the European subsidiary of the NAGASE Group from Japan – a globally leading trading and service company headquartered in Düsseldorf. As part of a worldwide network, we combine innovation and quality while focusing on forward-looking industries: specialty and fine chemicals, plastics, pharmaceuticals, enzymes, and solutions for the electronics and semiconductor industries.With offices in Düsseldorf, London, Budapest, Lyon, and Istanbul, we maintain a strong presence across Europe. We provide our customers with tailored products, technical expertise, and excellent service – always with the ambition to deliver the highest possible quality.Our goal: to work together with our partners to create innovative solutions that truly make a difference.

Full-time/Part-time (min. 32h/w) | Dresden | Hybrid (regular mobile work possible)Do you have a passion for high-quality software development and clean, maintainable code?Are you excited about applying machine learning, image processing, and pattern recognition to develop innovative solutions for medical and diagnostic applications?Do you enjoy transforming complex data into intelligent algorithms while working at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and life sciences?Dive into our AI!Your tasks You will take algorithms from research into real-world applications:• You’ll explore new machine learning approaches for holographic microscopy.• You’ll help shape our device design together with our hardware and optics experts, ensuring that the device captures the data your algorithms need.• Together with our biomedical experts, you’ll plan how data is collected and annotated.• You’ll build in-house tools that support colleagues across the company with annotation, calibration, and analysis.• You’ll dive into the data to identify what is holding a model back, whether it’s the data, the optics, or the algorithm itself.• You’ll own your algorithms end to end: developing, documenting, rigorously testing, and optimizing them to run efficiently on our embedded devices.Our current focus is on improving our holographic microscopy-based devices, although spectrometry occasionally comes into play. **Do you enjoy bridging the gap between people and departments? Do you find it easy to communicate with different audiences and are interested in both the business and technical aspects of your work? Then we have the right position for you! Vestas is looking for a Plant Technical Support Engineer, Specialist (m/f/d)!**Region NCE and Global Offshore > NCE > Technical Operations North Technical Operations is part of Service NCE (Northern & Central Europe) and supports the organization in the installation and maintenance of a variety of SCADA systems for the control of medium- and large-scale wind turbines. Our mission is to transform a group of wind turbines into a fully operational power plant that meets contractual and regional requirements. Our customers are mainly larger energy supply companies and professional investors.Your tasks As a Plant Operations Specialist, you are the technical anchor point for the entire department. You will report directly to the Director and contribute to the strategic and technical direction of the division.- Maintain an overview of new research and development (R&D) products and accompany their operational implementation- Actively support technical escalations and risks for our business- Be the point of contact for our four technical communities and ensure that initiatives are aligned and add value to the business- Actively engage stakeholders and participate in global and regional communities- Advise management on technical gaps, priorities, regional risks, etc.Qualifications We are looking for candidates with proven leadership experience in a technical environment. This position does not focus primarily on your technical expertise, but on your ability to identify synergies, align stakeholders around common goals, and steer the technical agenda in a way that adds value to the business. You will be part of an operational department, but at the same time you will have the overarching perspective.- Degree or comparable educational background in information technology, automation technology or telecommunications- Strong leadership skills, for example as a project manager or manager- knowledge of the wind energy industry; Experience with SCADA systems is an advantage- Fluent in written and spoken EnglishCompetencies- Excellent communication skills as well as the ability to convey complex technical topics in an understandable way- Professional skills in stakeholder management- Ability to work independently and set the technical direction for a teamWhat we offer We offer an exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, cooperative and international working environment within renewable energies. We attach great importance to initiative, a sense of responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. With the appropriate motivation, performance and potential, you will have attractive career prospects within Vestas.Learn more Your primary place of work will be Aarhus or Videbæk in Denmark. Alternatively, Malmö (Sweden) as well as Husum or Hamburg (Germany) are also possible.You should expect to travel for about 20 days per year.
